executiveSummary.headline: Protect a Strong Peer Position With Clearer, Consistent Commercial Facts
executiveSummary.lead: AC Hotel A Coruña ranks second among six certified Marriott Bonvoy peers and appears in 60.4% of eligible scenarios, but several important facts are either inconsistent across public sources or only partly recognized in the ADP baseline.
